description: This file defines a template class 'EnumerateType' for handling enumerations with string conversion capabilities, including methods for assignment, comparison, and lookup. It also includes macros for generating conversion tables and references several local include files.

classes.name: EnumerateType
classes.description: A template class for managing enumeration values with string conversion, comparison, and assignment functionalities.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator overloads for copying, moving, and assigning from enum, uint32_t, and text fragments.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the enumeration value is set.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the enumeration value.
